gaps.construct: sourcehook is an overridable method on shlex, documented as a hook for subclasses
gaps.description: No methods, self or overriding; written as a free operation taking the lexer, so the hook can no longer be replaced by a subclass.
No character literal, no indexing of Text and no slice with a negative end; 'first character of' and 'characters 1 until (length of name - 1) of name' are invented.
No run-time type test on a dynamically typed field; the field is modelled as a choice Named/Unnamed and tested with choose.
No tuple type; a SourcedFile record is declared just to return two values.

gaps.construct: returns an open file the caller must close
gaps.description: The doc shows only hold (scoped) and says an unreleased let-bound file is rejected; how an operation hands an open linear resource to its caller, especially inside a record, is not shown.

gaps.construct: newfile[0] on an empty string raises IndexError
gaps.description: The doc does not say what an out-of-range access on Text does, so this failure is not represented.

gaps.construct: if isinstance(...) with no else branch
gaps.description: choose must cover every variant, and there is no 'do nothing' statement; whether a when branch holding only a note is valid is not stated.
The doc never sets a parameter; a var 'name' is introduced, so the original name is not kept.

invented_syntax: characters 1 until (length of name - 1) of name
open name for reading using files (without hold)
a SourcedFile with name name and stream stream (record construction)
notes: A nine-line method exposes three basic gaps: text indexing and slicing, returning more than one value, and handing an open resource to the caller. Record construction syntax is also missing from the doc; example 29's 'an Order from cart and receipt with status Paid' is the only hint and is not general. Escape rules inside Text literals are not stated.
